uncovered_items.detail: Exact string intersections do not test normalized, case-folded, token-level, paraphrased, or near-duplicate overlap.
Train original_row_id and validation_row_id belong to different splits; numeric equality across splits is not treated as overlap evidence.
Current files, local caches, versions, and static source literals do not prove every historical remote execution used the same bytes or environment.
No model was loaded and no training or remote experiment was run; dynamic behavior outside the extracted literals is not audited.

summary.interpretation: Report only the completed checks. A zero exact-match count means no exact string match in those compared sets; it is not absolute isolation. Missing/failed checks are null or not_available and support neither a leakage claim nor a no-leakage claim.
